test_rolling_window_type_constructor: test constructing a rolling window with scipy win_type and window size parameters
test_invalid_rolling_constructor_params: test that invalid min_periods, center, and win_type values raise appropriate errors
test_rolling_agg_function_support: test that unsupported aggregation functions like median, kurt, skew raise AttributeError
test_weighted_moving_window_operations: test weighted moving mean, std, var, and sum with boxcar win_type on Series and DataFrame
test_special_window_types_with_args: test kaiser, gaussian, general_gaussian, and exponential window types with extra keyword arguments
test_weighted_window_corner_cases: test rolling window with all-nan data, empty data, and window larger than series length
test_weighted_window_with_step_parameter: test rolling window aggregation with step parameter for subsampling results
test_weighted_window_with_missing_data: test weighted rolling mean with missing data and min_periods across multiple window types
